reports.title: Restart level leaves the game paused instead of running
reports.observed: After pausing and clicking btn-restart, the state shows mode=paused, the pause menu stays open, and a further wait tick does nothing (time stays 300, player stays at (1,1)).
reports.expected: Restart level resets the level (score 0, 3 lives, items back) and the game is running again straight away (mode=playing, pause menu closed, timer ticks on the next running tick).
